reviews.title: Comfortable from the first run
reviews.text: Wore them straight out of the box for a 10k and had no hot spots at all. The cushioning feels soft without being mushy, and they still feel fresh after a few weeks of easy runs.
reviews.name: Priya S.

reviews.title: My daily trainer now
reviews.text: I rotate between a few shoes and these have become the pair I reach for most. Good grip on wet pavement and the fit is true to size for me.
reviews.name: Daniel K.

reviews.title: Great, slightly narrow
reviews.text: Really like the ride and the look. The toe box is a little narrow for my feet so I went up half a size, which fixed it.
reviews.name: Meera R.

reviews.title: Good for walking too
reviews.text: Bought these for running but I end up wearing them all day at work. Light, comfortable and the colourway goes with everything.
reviews.name: Tom W.

reviews.title: Solid all-rounder
reviews.text: Nothing flashy, just a dependable shoe. I would like a bit more energy return on faster runs but for easy miles it is excellent.
reviews.name: Aisha B.

reviews.title: Fits like my old pair
reviews.text: Same size as my previous Pegasus and it fits the same. Upper is more breathable than I expected.
reviews.name: Luis M.

reviews.title: Okay, laces too long
reviews.text: Comfortable shoe but the laces are very long and keep coming undone. Swapped them out and it is fine now.
reviews.name: Hannah C.

reviews.title: Half marathon tested
reviews.text: Ran my first half in these. Feet felt good the whole way and no blisters afterwards.
reviews.name: Arjun P.
